ios.desc:
NEW: Lock Screen Widgets
NEW: Dynamic Island Support when leaving the app while learning
NEW: Share any word as an animated video
NEW: Improved Search, Spotlight Search integration
NEW: LingoTime now supports writing recognition.
NEW: Add widgets to your home screen and study at a glance.

Available for Apple Watch, iPad, iPhone and Mac.

LingoTime is your language learning companion to study Japanese words and kanji, intermediate English, French, German, Russian, and Spanish.

With interactive notifications, AI powered reminders and Widgets, it supports you to acquire new words effectively.

LingoTime is on all Apple platforms, so you can study anywhere.

Key Highlights:

• AI powered Spaced Repetition System
• Get notifications based on specific words for repetition
• Learn at a glance with widgets
• Kanji Writing Recognition
• Display stroke order animations for 3000+ Kanji
• Search the dictionary and create custom lists
• Earn Badges and track your daily progress
• Prepare for common certifications e.g. JLPT, Kanji Kentei, TOEIC, TOEFL

LingoTime doesn't require a registration.All your progress is synced automatically through iCloud to all your Apple devices.

Language learning, anytime, anywhere.

„LingoTime makes learning Japanese a daily habit. You can learn just about anywhere.“

„LingoTime: Language Learning Redefined“

„Learn a new language with a glance at any device.“

The App Contains In-App Purchases.
